fields.why: 'Family income was imputed when missing' is data handling for a stratifier, closest to the brief's non-procedure 'data cleaning'; nothing in the analysis rests on it. The brief does not name imputation; rule: single imputation of missing covariates is not a procedure (multiple imputation used for inference would be 'other').

brief_issues: Add imputation of missing values to the 'not procedures' list (or say when it counts).
